name: Electric Charge, Greater
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as electric charge except it deals 3 electricity damage per round and if the target critically fails their saving throw, they are stunned for until the beginning of their next turn.
